name: Agent sandbox comparison (10 options, 2026)
description: Third-party comparison of ten agent sandbox tools with concrete selection advice.
descriptionZh: 第三方对十款 Agent 沙箱工具的比较，并给出具体选型建议。
frontier: Recommendations: Membrane (Docker + eBPF) for balance, NVIDIA OpenShell for Kubernetes policy, Agent Safehouse for macOS, Docker Sandboxes for Docker-in-Docker
frontierZh: 建议：Membrane（Docker + eBPF）适合均衡；NVIDIA OpenShell 适合 Kubernetes 策略；Agent Safehouse 适合 macOS；Docker Sandboxes 适合 Docker-in-Docker
credibility: Useful because it names the trade-off rather than a winner. Two corrections matter: Agent Safehouse and Membrane are real but small projects, and one widely circulated version of this comparison attributes Docker-in-Docker support to E2B — the original recommends Docker Sandboxes for that, while E2B's pitch is managed cloud isolation with no local install.
credibilityZh: 价值在于它点出取舍而非评选唯一赢家。两点需纠正：Agent Safehouse 与 Membrane 真实但项目很小；另外流传的一个版本把 Docker-in-Docker 推荐记到了 E2B 头上——原文该位置推荐的是 Docker Sandboxes，而 E2B 的卖点是无需本地安装的托管云隔离。
keyFact: A 20 March 2026 comparison of ten agent sandbox tools recommended Membrane (Docker plus eBPF monitoring) for the best security-to-simplicity balance, NVIDIA OpenShell for enterprise policy enforcement on Kubernetes, Agent Safehouse for macOS users and Docker Sandboxes for Docker-in-Docker needs.
keyFactZh: 2026 年 3 月 20 日发布的十款 Agent 沙箱对比建议：追求安全与简洁的均衡选 Membrane（Docker + eBPF 监控）；需要 Kubernetes 上的企业级策略执行选 NVIDIA OpenShell；macOS 用户选 Agent Safehouse；需要 Docker-in-Docker 能力选 Docker Sandboxes。
debunks: The claim that the comparison recommends E2B for Docker-in-Docker.
debunksZh: 「该对比推荐用 E2B 来做 Docker-in-Docker」这一说法。
